# Use existing REPL variables if present; otherwise fail clearly
required_vars = ['filtered','venmo_access_token','friends_emails','start_date','end_date']
missing = [v for v in required_vars if v not in globals()]
print('missing_vars', missing)

# If filtered not present, recompute minimal (read) by reusing date_range and tokens
if missing:
    print('Recomputing filtered set...')
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    transactions = []
    while True:
        page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
            access_token=venmo_access_token,
            min_created_at=start_date,
            max_created_at=end_date,
            direction='received',
            page_index=page_index,
            page_limit=page_limit
        )
        if not page:
            break
        transactions.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    friends_set = set(friends_emails)
    filtered = [t for t in transactions if t.get('sender', {}).get('email') in friends_set]

# Get my venmo email
my_email = apis.venmo.show_account(access_token=venmo_access_token).get('email')
print('my_venmo_email', my_email)

thanks_txns_need_comment = []
thanks_txns_already_commented = []

# For each filtered txn: check comments for an existing authored "Thanks!"
for t in filtered:
    txn_id = t.get('transaction_id')
    # paginate comments
    comments = []
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    while True:
        page = apis.venmo.show_transaction_comments(
            transaction_id=txn_id,
            access_token=venmo_access_token,
            page_index=page_index,
            page_limit=page_limit
        )
        if not page:
            break
        comments.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    has_thanks_by_me = any((c.get('comment') == 'Thanks!') and (c.get('user', {}).get('email') == my_email) for c in comments)
    if has_thanks_by_me:
        thanks_txns_already_commented.append(txn_id)
    else:
        thanks_txns_need_comment.append(txn_id)

# Determine which need like
likes_need = []
likes_already = []
for t in filtered:
    txn_id = t.get('transaction_id')
    if t.get('liked'):
        likes_already.append(txn_id)
    else:
        likes_need.append(txn_id)

print('filtered_count', len(filtered))
print('txns_need_comment_count', len(thanks_txns_need_comment))
print('txns_already_commented_count', len(thanks_txns_already_commented))
print('txns_need_like_count', len(likes_need))
print('txns_already_liked_count', len(likes_already))
print('need_comment_ids', sorted(thanks_txns_need_comment))
print('need_like_ids', sorted(likes_need))

# <playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Not sure whether Venmo API allows duplicate comments; I checked for existing "Thanks!" by me before creating.</uncertainty>

created_comment_ids = []
comment_failures = []

for txn_id in thanks_txns_need_comment:
    try:
        res = apis.venmo.create_transaction_comment(
            transaction_id=txn_id,
            comment='Thanks!',
            access_token=venmo_access_token
        )
        created_comment_ids.append((txn_id, res.get('comment_id')))
        print('comment_created', txn_id, res)
    except Exception as e:
        comment_failures.append((txn_id, str(e)))
        print('comment_failed', txn_id, str(e))

liked_ids = []
like_failures = []

for txn_id in likes_need:
    try:
        res = apis.venmo.like_transaction(
            transaction_id=txn_id,
            access_token=venmo_access_token
        )
        liked_ids.append(txn_id)
        print('like_done', txn_id, res)
    except Exception as e:
        like_failures.append((txn_id, str(e)))
        print('like_failed', txn_id, str(e))

print('summary_created_comments', len(created_comment_ids), 'failures', len(comment_failures))
print('summary_likes', len(liked_ids), 'failures', len(like_failures))
print('comment_failures', comment_failures)
print('like_failures', like_failures)
